data.exact_reserve_text: Underwriting performance has been further supplemented by favourable development from prior accident years. Due to a light incurred claims development on short tail lines the Syndicate has released reserves of GBP 2.3m (2013: GBP 4.5m) from Property. The Syndicate also experienced light incurred claims development and a release of claims provision in prior years in relation to Professional Lines and Accident & Health business, resulting in favourable prior year development of GBP 3.4m (2013: GBP 5.0m) and GBP 2.3m (2013: loss GBP 0.4m) respectively.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced favourable prior year development of GBP 8.0 million in 2014, primarily driven by light incurred claims development on short tail lines. This included releases of GBP 2.3 million from Property reserves, GBP 3.4 million from Professional Lines, and GBP 2.3 million from Accident & Health business. The overall improvement in performance was also attributed to a reduction in the frequency and severity of risk loss activity and the absence of catastrophe losses during the current accident year.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development from prior accident years
light incurred claims development on short tail lines
reduction in the frequency and severity of risk loss activity experienced in prior years
absence of catastrophe loss activity during the current accident year
